caption: Figure 1. I/O accelerating architectures across three deploy- ment models: (a) bare-metal with an exclusive NIC, (b) VMs with virtual NIC, and (c) VMs with SmartNICs.

templates.why_chosen: Named in the reference as the bare-metal/VM/SmartNIC-of-increasing-complexity exemplar: panels (b) and (c) reuse the VM0/VM1/QEMU-KVM/NICs skeleton from (a), adding only the SmartNIC internals plus two colour-coded numbered paths in (c).
templates.what_to_learn: Grow the panels by increasing complexity while reusing the prior panel's skeleton wholesale (VM boxes, QEMU/KVM, NICs) so only new hardware stands out, and overlay two independently coloured numbered paths (data-plane blue, control-plane red) on the final panel rather than adding a fourth; keep each path shorter than this figure's dense two-by-five overlay.
